# 扶摇提示词 FUYAO PROMPT

> 扶摇提示词优化在浏览器本地处理 AI 提示词（浏览器本地运行，不上传服务端），口号「让每一句话都抟风」，纯引流站点。

FUYAO PROMPT is part of FUYAO STUDIO (https://iforworlds.com), a human + AI cross-media creative studio. FUYAO PROMPT optimizes AI prompts entirely in your browser (local processing, nothing uploaded). Motto: "Let every sentence catch the wind"; a pure-traffic site.

- Homepage: https://prompt.iforworlds.com/
